steps.expected: Toast shown; audit log entry recorded; public URL returns a not-found/unavailable state, not stale content

cases.disposition_reason: publishing/unpublishing an entry of a page-level configuration object (SINGLETON) may displace or hide the live QCDEMO entry every visitor sees - automate only once it is confirmed live that a QCTEST entry renders without replacing it; otherwise skip: needs a real shared record mutated
cases.account: QC Site Content Editor via cms_role_credentials('Site Content Editor')

cases.title: Verify that a submission can reach the Closed status as an alternate terminal state to Completed

steps.action: As Form Manager, with a submission currently Under Review, change status to 'Closed'

steps.expected: Save succeeds; status shows Closed; toast shown; audit log records the transition with timestamp + acting user; no email sent

cases.disposition_reason: needs a QCTEST submission/subscriber to mutate; real visitor records may only be read - automate only once a QCTEST record can be created (public form without a CAPTCHA wall, or an authoring add) and deleted by exact reference
cases.account: QC Form Manager via cms_role_credentials('Form Manager')
